$schema.description: A JSON Schema for editors. Ignored by OpenDemo.

url.description: The page to record. Use this or `screens`.
The page this screen opens first.

frame.description: browser-safari (default), browser-chrome, mobile-iphone or none. Phones show taps instead of a cursor.

viewport.description: The page size in CSS pixels. Default: the top-level viewport. Not for phone frames, which have their own size.

screens.description: Named screens, each its own browser page with its own cookies. The first one is on camera at the start. Use this or `url`.

viewport.description: The page size in CSS pixels. Default: 1440 x 900.

device-scale-factor.description: Pixel density of the recording. Default: 3.

zoom.description: The scale of `zoom: true` steps and `zoom-in`. Default: 1.8.

zoom-hold-ms.description: How long the camera stays zoomed after a step ends. Default: 300.

path.description: Where to write the video. `--out` on the command line overrides it. Default: the script's name with .mp4, or opendemo.mp4 for a script from stdin.

background.description: An image file shown behind the window.

padding.description: Space around the window, as a share of the video size. Default: 0.08.

radius.description: Corner radius of the window, as a share of the video size. Default: 0.018.

motion-blur.description: 0 (off) to 1 (strong), only while the camera or cursor moves. Default: 0.5.

travel-ms.description: Longest time the pointer takes to move to a target. Default: 800.

font-size.description: In video pixels. Default: 3% of the video height.

style.description: How the video looks. Changing it only needs `opendemo render`.

url.description: A full URL, or a path relative to the current page.

caption.description: Text shown before the step runs, until the next caption. The step waits until it can be read.

target.description: The element, as a Playwright selector: `text=Save`, `#id`, `button:has-text("Save")`, `[data-testid=x]`. Quote selectors that start with #.

zoom.description: Zoom in on the target: `true` uses the script's `zoom` scale, a number zooms to that scale.

items.description: The element, as a Playwright selector: `text=Save`, `#id`, `button:has-text("Save")`, `[data-testid=x]`. Quote selectors that start with #.

keep-in-view.description: Other elements to keep in frame with the target while zoomed, usually what the step changes (a new row, a toast). Needs `zoom`.

anyOf.description: Click an input and type into it, one key at a time. On a native date or time input it types the value into the input's parts (day, hour, AM/PM) the way a person would.

target.description: The `<select>`, or the element that opens the dropdown, as a Playwright selector.

option.description: The option's visible text, exactly as shown.

anyOf.description: Pick an option from a dropdown. On a native `<select>` the pointer opens a menu drawn in the video (the browser doesn't film its own) and clicks the option. On a dropdown made of page elements it clicks the target, then the option.

key.description: A key name as Playwright writes it: Enter, Tab, Escape, ArrowDown, Meta+A.

caption.description: Text shown before the step runs, until the next caption. The step waits until it can be read.

anyOf.description: Press a key or a key combination.

target.description: The element to bring into view, as a Playwright selector. Use this or `y`.

y.description: Pixels to scroll with the mouse wheel: positive goes down, negative goes up. Use this or `target`.

caption.description: Text shown before the step runs, until the next caption. The step waits until it can be read.

anyOf.description: Scroll the page: smoothly until an element is in view, centered if it had to move (`target`), or by a number of pixels with the mouse wheel (`y`). Steps that point at an element already scroll to it, so use this to show something without pointing at it.

target.description: The element to wait for, as a Playwright selector.

anyOf.description: Wait until an element is visible. Use it after anything that loads.

anyOf.description: Wait, so the viewer can take in what is on screen.

screen.description: The name of a screen from `screens`.

transition.description: How the video moves there: fade (default) or slide. A slide goes left to a screen listed later in `screens`, right to one listed earlier.

caption.description: Text shown before the step runs, until the next caption. The step waits until it can be read.

anyOf.description: Move the video to another screen. The steps after it run there.

as.description: The name later steps use as `${name}`. Letters, digits and _.

target.description: The element to read, as a Playwright selector. Its text is stored, or its `attribute`.

attribute.description: An attribute of the target to store instead of its text, like href or value. href and src come back as full URLs.

from.description: Store the current page URL, or the clipboard (after a step that copies). Use instead of `target`.

caption.description: Text shown before the step runs, until the next caption. The step waits until it can be read.

anyOf.description: Store a value that only exists while the script runs (a link, an ID it just created). Later steps use it as `${name}` in any text. Takes no time in the video.

target.description: The element to zoom in on, as a Playwright selector.

items.description: The element, as a Playwright selector: `text=Save`, `#id`, `button:has-text("Save")`, `[data-testid=x]`. Quote selectors that start with #.

keep-in-view.description: Other elements to keep in frame with the target, measured when the zoom starts. The camera centers on all of them and zooms out below the scale if they don't fit.

caption.description: Text shown before the step runs, until the next caption. The step waits until it can be read.

anyOf.description: Zoom the camera in on an element (a form, a dialog, a menu, a table row) and stay zoomed for the steps after it, until `zoom-out`, a `goto` or a `switch`. The camera follows the steps inside it. It waits a moment so the camera gets there before the next step.
Zoom the camera back out to the whole page after `zoom-in`.

Stop recording, like the pause button on a screen recorder. The steps after it still run, at full speed, but aren't in the video. Use it for setup the viewer doesn't need to see. They can't have captions or zoom.
Continue recording after pause-recording. If a paused `switch` moved to another screen, the video moves there using that switch's transition and caption.
